title: EHR Training Specialist
description: Pivot Point Consulting seeks a talented EHR Training Specialist to lead our athenahealth implementation initiatives. You will work closely with clinical stakeholders, IT teams, and executive leadership to deliver solutions that improve efficiency and patient outcomes. Experience with athenahealth Core is essential.
responsibilities: Collaborate with clinical stakeholders to gather requirements and design optimal workflows
Configure and customize athenahealth applications to meet organizational needs
Develop and maintain project documentation, including design specifications and test plans
Participate in system testing, including unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing
Provide go-live support and post-implementation optimization
Develop comprehensive training curricula and materials
Conduct classroom and one-on-one training sessions for end users
Create quick reference guides and e-learning modules
Assess training effectiveness and identify knowledge gaps
Provide at-the-elbow support during go-live events

required_qualifications.education: Bachelor's degree in Health Informatics, Healthcare Administration, IT, or related field
required_qualifications.experience: 5+ years of healthcare IT implementation experience

certifications: Certified Professional in Healthcare Information and Management Systems (CPHIMS)
